headline: Maersk confirms data theft amid $5M extortion; CI secret stealer hit 1,806+ GitHub repos; Apache HTTP/2 RCE CVE-2026-119618

bullets.text: New: SecurityWeek reports Maersk has confirmed data theft amid a $5 million extortion attempt; WhiteArmor claims 100GB stolen. Also new: Help Net Security on .NET 11 security changes aimed at the software supply chain.
An attacker used 4,837 hijacked GitHub accounts to run a CI secret stealer in more than 1,806 repositories, per The Hacker News. Treat CI secrets exposed to workflows in affected repos as at risk.
Critical Apache HTTP Server flaw CVE-2026-119618 in HTTP/2 could let unauthenticated attackers execute code remotely, per Wiz and The Hacker News. The brief gives no fixed release.

ScreenConnect attacks with rogue clients have hit at least 288 endpoints across 48 organizations, breaching MSPs. N-central remains offline after a researcher published dozens of zero-days (6 outlets).

KEV due 11-13: Barracuda ESG CVE-2026-116606 and CVE-2026-111560 (exploited, 4 outlets) and Ivanti Connect Secure CVE-2026-104935. Due today 11-12: OpenSSH CVE-2026-123158, GPUStack, FreeSwitch, IBM Aspera Faspex. Due 11-24: Cisco BroadWorks, Openwave, Outlook, Chromium.

Also active: critical Xen Orchestra flaws exploited (3 outlets); Vanderbilt on lockdown after ransomware (6 outlets); France blames Iran for sabotage at about 700 retail sites (5 outlets). SITCON 3 holds; the week runs 1.07x the 90-day average.

actions: Review GitHub audit logs and recent workflow runs for unfamiliar accounts; rotate secrets exposed to CI and limit workflows from outside contributors.
Find internet-facing Apache HTTP Server hosts with HTTP/2 enabled; restrict exposure and patch as soon as a fixed release or distro package ships.
Inventory ScreenConnect instances, remove unknown or rogue clients, patch, and review session logs; keep N-central access restricted.
Barracuda ESG: apply fixes for CVE-2026-116606 and CVE-2026-111560 by 11-13 and hunt for compromise; patch Ivanti Connect Secure.
Confirm OpenSSH, GPUStack, FreeSwitch and IBM Aspera Faspex patches are done today, their KEV deadline.
Keep Xen Orchestra off the internet; patch Outlook, Chrome, Cisco BroadWorks and Openwave by 11-24.
